name: StreamLink (beta)
subtitle: The StreamLink iOS app, beta channel. For a server on the beta branch.
description: Install StreamLink through SideStore or AltStore and get updates without building the app yourself. The app is a client: it needs your own StreamLink server.

apps.name: StreamLink
apps.subtitle: Your StreamLink library on your phone.
apps.localizedDescription:
The iOS app for a StreamLink server. Browse and play your library, keep watching with the phone locked, send video to a TV with AirPlay or Chromecast, and download episodes to watch offline.

You need your own StreamLink server running at home. The app does nothing on its own.

versions.localizedDescription: The offline player refreshes whatever the download settings say

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: StreamLink finds TVs on this Wi-Fi and shares the episode you are watching with the one you pick (AirPlay or Chromecast).
